story.title: Geography Trivia

questions.q: The **Sahara** Desert is on which continent?
Wild **Komodo dragons** live in only one country. Which?
The **Mekong** reaches the sea in which country?
Which is the only **sea with no coastline**?

lines.q: The Sahara Desert is on which continent?
Table Mountain towers over which city?
lines.a: Cape Town! Its flat top is about three kilometres wide.

lines.q: Wild Komodo dragons live in only one country. Which one?
lines.a: Indonesia! On just a handful of islands.

lines.q: Which of these cities is furthest north? New York, Philadelphia, Washington, or Rome?
lines.a: Rome! It's further north than New York. Did that one get you?

lines.q: The Mekong River reaches the sea in which country?
lines.a: Vietnam! Through the huge Mekong Delta.

lines.q: Last one. Which is the only sea in the world with no coastline?
lines.a: The Sargasso Sea! It's bordered only by ocean currents. Follow if you got all six!
